2607.11698.title: Agent Hacks Agent: Autoresearch for Production-Agent Red-Teaming
2607.11698.paper_summary: Production LLM agents such as Claude Code and Codex operate over untrusted content, files, commands, and workspace state, making safety failures directly actionable. Red-teaming must therefore keep pace with evolving models and tools. Existing approaches mainly optimize attack success and preserve artifacts such as benchmarks, payloads, or attack programs, which record where attacks succeed but not the enabling conditions behind unsafe agent behavior. We study automated red-teaming for production LLM agents using one agentic research environment to discover reusable vulnerability knowledge about another. We present AHA, a falsifiable discovery loop that proposes a vulnerability hypothesis, constructs a falsifier, instantiates a valid attack, executes it in a sandboxed harness, reflects on the trajectory, and promotes confirmed findings into a Vulnerability Concept Graph (VCG). Each concept links an attacker-facing surface to an unsafe trajectory through a claim, enabling condition, falsifier, transfer prediction, and supporting evidence. Across Claude Code and Codex on three scenarios covering direct and indirect attacks, the discovered concepts reveal a reusable vulnerability core across models and agents. A frozen VCG requires no further search and outperforms the strongest frozen discovery baseline by 14.2 percentage points under the same single-shot protocol, while transferring across scenarios and attack channels. The resulting VCG provides an auditable artifact for production safety teams to inspect vulnerabilities, validate patches, and accumulate reusable safety knowledge. Our code is available at https://github.com/henrymao2004/Auto-research-red-teaming-in-sleep.
2607.11698.paper_summary_zh: 生產 LLM 代理如 Claude Code 和 Codex 在不受信任的內容、文件、命令和工作區狀態上運作，使得安全失敗可以直接被行動化。因此，紅隊必須跟上不斷演變的模型和工具。現有的方法主要優化攻擊成功率並保留基準、有效載荷或攻擊程序等工件，這些工件記錄了攻擊成功的地方，但並未揭示不安全代理行為背後的促成條件。我們研究了針對生產 LLM 代理的自動化紅隊，利用一個代理研究環境來發現另一個代理的可重用漏洞知識。我們提出了 AHA，一個可證偽的發現循環，它提出一個漏洞假設，構建一個證偽者，實例化一個有效的攻擊，在沙盒環境中執行，反思其軌跡，並將確認的發現推進到漏洞概念圖（VCG）中。每個概念將面對攻擊者的表面與通過主張、促成條件、證偽者、轉移預測和支持證據的不安全軌跡連結起來。在涵蓋直接和間接攻擊的三個場景中，Claude Code 和 Codex 上發現的概念揭示了跨模型和代理的可重用漏洞核心。一個凍結的 VCG 不需要進一步搜索，並在相同的單次協議下比最強的凍結發現基線高出 14.2 個百分點，同時在場景和攻擊通道之間轉移。最終生成的 VCG 為生產安全團隊提供了一個可審計的工件，以檢查漏洞、驗證補丁並積累可重用的安全知識。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/henrymao2004/Auto-research-red-teaming-in-sleep 獲得。
